metadata.description: Add-ons for Houston: Claude Code plugins with a signed houston-addon.json.

plugins.name: hello
plugins.description: A starting point for a Houston add-on: a sidebar section, a command and a skill.

plugins.name: theme-dusk
plugins.description: Example: A dark theme with warm accents, as a Houston add-on.

plugins.name: agents-screen
plugins.description: Example: A ⌘K screen listing every agent Houston sees, with each one's details.

plugins.name: scratchpad
plugins.description: Example: A sidebar scratchpad with keyboard shortcuts: one opens it, one stamps the time into it.

plugins.name: context-panels
plugins.description: Example: Panels beside an agent, a mission, a chat and a terminal tab, showing where each opened.

plugins.name: event-log
plugins.description: Example: A sidebar section that lists what happens in Houston as it happens.

plugins.name: board-tools
plugins.description: Example: Move missions, pause schedules and write a memory from one screen, each with your yes.

plugins.name: agent-starter
plugins.description: Example: Start a Claude Code or Codex agent on a task in a folder you name, with your yes.

plugins.name: github-status
plugins.description: Example: Checks githubstatus.com and tells you when GitHub isn't all green.
